strongest_findings.conclusion: Weight loading already uses bounded Scheduler/IoContext/FileResourcePipeline; hot integer/request storage uses reserved vectors/SmallVector and a fixed FIFO. Output facts are cold-indexed; Graph uses prepared binding spans and reserved full keys. No measured reason to mechanically substitute containers or add a second scheduler/cache.

strongest_findings.area: No-record host stages in retained diagnostic
strongest_findings.conclusion: 45 original no-record episodes: mean prepare0.633568ms, including replay0.255652ms; publication/retirement0.015825ms. Finish/wait13.120427ms overlaps12.708460ms GPU activity. Nested/overlapped intervals are not added or treated as removable host time.

Late T2 target Hyle23/peer25 captured intervals differ by mean+0.316575ms; draft by-0.026362ms. Largest positive family is66 N6144/K2048 projections,+0.340235ms, partly offset by faster vocabulary head. Existing MMVF/Lt routes remain closed absent a new mechanism.
strongest_findings.limit: These are retained instrumented subsets with explicit outside activities and precision/work differences, not a decomposition of the current complete9.6-9.9% throughput gap.

strongest_findings.conclusion: Public CPU Context options already accept borrowed ParallelExecutorRef and native_threads. Engine Backend did not forward them and used native_threads=1. A narrow cold forwarding seam can reuse those facilities; default all-core pools or global ATen setters are not justified.
strongest_findings.status: Selected for implementation and finite checks separately.

strongest_findings.conclusion: Original step reporting is inside the natural consumer journey and costs about0.13ms per call in an earlier retained diagnostic, including synchronous stream IO. Coalescing within the same call while preserving bytes/order/format and synchronous delivery is a legitimate candidate.
strongest_findings.status: Private host probe/consumer screening is separate evidence; no whole-engine gain claimed here.

strongest_findings.area: Further native state and metadata ideas
strongest_findings.conclusion: ik_llama direct state-copy fusion and SGLang multi-state slot operations are concrete source ideas. Hyle old Snapshot ownership prevents blind in-place adoption; existing CopyBatch/delta metadata routes must be measured first. DeepInfer metadata kernels and Strata residency ideas have explicit model/hardware/cold-capacity prerequisites. deepseek-recipe inspected code is Rust protocol/token stream processing, with no CUDA/KV mechanism in that read scope.
